faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: 14 days with full access to every module. No credit card required, and the trial ends automatically unless you pick a plan.
faq.a2: Authentication and file storage are hosted in Stockholm. Full data-residency documentation will be published together with the privacy policy.
faq.a3: Yes. Monthly plans have no lock-in and can be cancelled at any time. You can export all of your data whenever you want — it is yours.
faq.q4: Do we get help migrating from our current system?
faq.a4: You import products and customers via CSV, or pull them straight in through the Fortnox integration. Bulk import is included in every plan.
faq.q5: Which currency are we billed in?
faq.a5: You choose SEK or EUR. Payment is by card via Stripe, and all prices exclude VAT.
